# Companion provisioning narration: acme/helper `spec-export`

**Mode.** The caller supplied `ROOT=/work/helper`, `BRANCH=spec-export` and `REMOTE_BRANCH=existing`, so I follow companion mode in `reference/pr-head.md`. That replaces Steps 0, 1 and 1a. `ROOT` is used exactly as given. The session's linked tree `/work/widget/.worktrees/other` is never used as `ROOT` or reused as a leg.

**Resolved values.**
- `NAME=spec-export`
- The overrides file has a `home:` key, so the keyed contract is active and `HOME=/work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export`.
- `create:` is absent, so the built-in creator applies.
- `WORKTREE=$HOME`.

**What companions never do.** They emit no `PR:` or `Pre-rework head:` lines. They read no `headRefOid`, `MEMBER_HEADS` or `PRE_REWORK_HEAD`. They write no `refs/gauntlet/*`, fetch no review threads, skip the cross-repo checks, and never pass `-b`.

## Command legend

The process cwd never changes. Every command targets its repo with `git -C`.

| Id | Command | Result (default) |
|---|---|---|
| G | `git -C /work/helper rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree` | empty, not a submodule |
| F | `git -C /work/helper fetch origin` | exit 0 |
| L | `git -C /work/helper ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin refs/heads/spec-export` | exit 0 |
| T | `git -C /work/helper rev-parse origin/spec-export` | `ORIGINAL_HEAD=O` |
| D | `gh repo view acme/helper --json defaultBranchRef -q .defaultBranchRef.name` | `trunk` |
| S | `git -C /work/helper rev-parse origin/trunk` | `BASE_SHA=B` |
| W | `git -C /work/helper worktree list --porcelain` | checked-out-elsewhere check |
| K | `git -C /work/helper show-ref --verify refs/heads/spec-export` | local branch tip |
| Q | `git -C /work/helper status --porcelain` | empty, source clean |
| I | `git -C /work/helper check-ignore -q .worktrees` | exit 0, already ignored, no write |
| RG | `git -C $WT rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path rebase-merge` and `… rebase-apply` | neither is a directory |
| P0 | `git -C /work/helper merge-base --is-ancestor O refs/heads/spec-export` | published-head ancestry for recovery |
| WALK | `git -C /work/helper log --first-parent --format='%H %P' origin/spec-export..refs/heads/spec-export` | recovery walk |
| AN | `git -C /work/helper merge-base --is-ancestor refs/heads/spec-export origin/spec-export` | ordinary ancestry check |
| ADD | `git -C /work/helper worktree add "/work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export" spec-export` | existing-branch DWIM, no `-b` |
| H | `git -C $WT rev-parse HEAD` | must equal `O`, or `R` on recovery |
| M | `git -C $WT merge --no-ff --no-edit origin/trunk` | `merge: no-op - head contains origin/trunk` |
| OA | `git -C $WT merge-base --is-ancestor O HEAD` | exit 0 |
| RB | W prints `worktree /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export`; `git -C $WT branch --show-current` prints `spec-export` | coordinated read-back |

`$WT` means `/work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export`.

**Shared prefix for every run:** G, F, L, T, D, S, Q, I, W, K.

- The default-branch probe `git -C /work/helper symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` returns empty, so the provenance note is skipped silently.
- The recovery rule (P0, WALK, clean tree) runs before the ancestry check AN, but only when the local tip is beyond `O`.

**Ready report**, used when a run says "Ready":

```
Worktree ready at /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export
Branch: spec-export
Base: spec-export @ aaaaaaa (clean)
Base SHA: bbbbbbb
merge: no-op - head contains origin/trunk
Ready to implement <feature>
```

**Preserved-legs inventory**, shown on every stop:
- Line `HOME`: `acme/widget spec-export /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export`
- Nothing is ever removed.

## Runs

| Run | Path after the shared prefix | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| absent | K finds no branch. Absent-tree, absent-branch row: ADD (DWIM gives `--track` from `origin/spec-export`). H=O, M, OA, RB. | Ready |
| ancestor | K=A. P0 exits 1, so A is not beyond O and recovery does not apply. AN exits 0 (A is an ancestor of O). Then `git -C /work/helper update-ref refs/heads/spec-export origin/spec-export`, ADD. H=O, M, OA, RB. | Ready |
| reuse | The tree exists at A. RG passes; recovery does not apply; AN exits 0. Selected-home row: dirty ask via `git -C $WT status --porcelain` (empty), then `git -C $WT merge --ff-only origin/spec-export`. H=O, M, OA, RB. | Ready |
| wrapper | `create: helper create -b <branch> <name>` contains `-b`, so it is not run. Built-in ADD instead. H=O, M, OA, RB. | Ready, plus the line `create: override skipped (contains -b)` |
| race | ADD succeeds, but H returns X. | **Stop**, details below |
| elsewhere | W lists `spec-export` at `/work/helper/.worktrees/foreign`. | **Stop before writes**, details below |
| missing | F exits 0. L exits 2, even though the stale `origin/spec-export` still resolves to O. | **Stop before writes**, details below |
| lookup-error | L exits 128. | **Stop before writes**, details below |
| unresolved | ADD, H=O. M conflicts. | **Stop, returned to caller**, details below |
| recover-tree | The tree exists at R. Recovery proof, details below. | Ready, with read-back R |
| recover-add | Same proof as recover-tree, but no tree exists. | Ready, with read-back R |
| invalid-linear | WALK returns the entry `X O`, which has one parent. | **Stop**, details below |
| invalid-parent | WALK returns `R O X`. `git -C /work/helper merge-base --is-ancestor X origin/trunk` exits 1. | **Stop**, details below |
| invalid-dirty | The proof passes, but `git -C $WT status --porcelain` shows `M lib/a.ts`. | **Stop**, details below |
| ordinary-control | Singleton PR acme/widget#82, no coordinated context. | **Stop**, details below |

### race

- Message: `acme/helper spec-export: /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export HEAD eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee, expected aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`.
- Nothing ready is emitted. The tree is left intact.
- Preserved legs: `HOME`, plus `acme/helper branch unverified /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export`.

### elsewhere

- Message: `acme/helper spec-export: branch spec-export is checked out at /work/helper/.worktrees/foreign; finish or remove that worktree first.`
- Preserved legs: `HOME`.

### missing

- Message: `origin/spec-export is missing in acme/helper; on the machine that ran option 6, push spec-export from that companion's checkout, then rerun brainstorming #N`.
- Remedy, on that machine:
  1. Confirm the leg-file commit: `git log -1 --format=%H -- <spec-dir>/<home spec filename>`.
  2. Then push: `git push -u origin spec-export`.
- If that commit exists on no machine, stop; do not regenerate it.
- Preserved legs: `HOME`.

### lookup-error

- Message: `acme/helper spec-export: ls-remote failed: fatal: unable to access origin`.
- Absence is not diagnosed.
- Preserved legs: `HOME`.

### unresolved

Helper sequence:
1. Snapshot `git -C $WT status --porcelain`.
2. Get conflicted paths: `git -C $WT diff --name-only --diff-filter=U` returns `lib/a.ts`.
3. Read the runner from the fetched base: `git -C /work/helper show B:<overrides path>`. This yields `SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS=node --test lib/a.test.mjs`.
4. Dispatch a fresh `implementer` with `cwd=$WT`, `async:false`, file `lib/a.ts`, base `origin/trunk`, that runner, and no commit or abort allowed.

After the helper fails:
- `git -C $WT merge --abort` exits 0.
- OA passes, since HEAD is O. RB passes.

Result:
- Recorded: `merge: unresolved - lib/a.ts`. This goes back to the coordinated caller for its by-hand stop, not to a home Task 1 continuation.
- No ready line is emitted.
- Preserved legs: `HOME`, plus `acme/helper spec-export /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export`.

### recover-tree and recover-add: what admits recovery

Recovery is admitted only when all of these hold:
1. The context is a companion in a coordinated run.
2. RG shows no rebase in progress.
3. K=R, which differs from O.
4. P0 exits 0.
5. WALK is non-empty, and every entry has two parents (here the single entry `R O B`).
6. `git -C /work/helper merge-base --is-ancestor B origin/trunk` exits 0.
7. The tree is clean (recover-tree only, since recover-add has no tree).

What happens after admission:
- recover-tree reuses the tree unchanged.
- recover-add runs ADD.
- Neither path uses update-ref, reset or `-b`.
- Both then run H=R, M (no-op), OA (O is an ancestor of R) and RB (reads back R).
- The ready report shows `Base: spec-export @ ddddddd (clean)` and appends `Base sync recovered: ddddddd`.

### invalid-linear, invalid-parent, invalid-dirty

- Each run fails exactly one proof requirement:
  - **invalid-linear:** the walk entry `X O` has one parent, so it is not a base merge.
  - **invalid-parent:** second parent X is not an ancestor of `origin/trunk`.
  - **invalid-dirty:** the selected tree is not clean.
- A failed proof falls to the existing ancestry stop. AN exits 1 in each case.
- Message: `acme/helper: local branch spec-export is at <eeeeeee|ddddddd|ddddddd>, not an ancestor of origin/spec-export (aaaaaaa); companion needs the published branch head.`
- Local commits and dirt are kept.
- Preserved legs: `HOME`, plus the existing helper tree for invalid-dirty.

### ordinary-control

Commands:
1. Derive `ROOT=/work/widget`.
2. `git -C /work/widget fetch origin`.
3. `git -C /work/widget rev-parse --verify -q O^{commit}` succeeds, and `origin/spec-export` equals O.
4. BASE_SHA=B.
5. Stops checked: in-repo, and W shows no other checkout.

Why recovery does not apply:
- There is no coordinated context, so the companion recovery does not apply.
- `refs/gauntlet/rework-base/pr-82` is absent and N=1, so the ancestry check always runs.
- The base-merge walk is not an exemption here.

The check `git -C /work/widget merge-base --is-ancestor spec-export origin/spec-export` exits 1.

**Stop before writes:** `local branch spec-export is at ddddddd, not an ancestor of origin/spec-export (aaaaaaa); rework needs the PR head.`

I'm using the using-git-worktrees skill to set up an isolated workspace.

This is a synthetic narration; I run no tools.

## Command and record legends

**Cwd:** Every shell command below runs with process cwd `/work/widget/.worktrees/other`. `git -C` selects the checkout without changing that cwd. The caller’s `/work/helper` is authoritative for companions; I never adopt the session’s linked tree.

**SHA arguments:** In the command legends, `O`, `B`, `A`, `R`, and `X` mean the full 40-character SHAs supplied in the question, substituted literally—not shell variable names. Reports use their seven-character abbreviations.

**Paths:**
- `H` = `/work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export`
- `W` = `/work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export`
- `NAME` = `spec-export`

Commands below containing `H` or `W` likewise use those full paths literally.

### I — Companion identity, live remote check, and configuration

In order:

```sh
git -C /work/helper rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-dir --git-common-dir
git -C /work/helper rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree
git -C /work/helper fetch origin
git -C /work/helper ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin refs/heads/spec-export
```

Resolve `GIT_DIR = GIT_COMMON = /work/helper/.git`; no superproject. The session’s linked worktree does not change `ROOT`.

**Stop immediately on a failed live lookup**, as specified in the corresponding rows. Otherwise continue:

```sh
git -C /work/helper rev-parse origin/spec-export
gh repo view acme/helper --json defaultBranchRef -q .defaultBranchRef.name
git -C /work/helper rev-parse origin/trunk
sh -c 'for p in /work/helper/.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md /work/helper/gauntlet-overrides.md /work/helper/doc/gauntlet-overrides.md; do if [ -f "$p" ]; then cat "$p"; break; fi; done'
cat /work/helper/.pi/settings.json
git -C /work/helper worktree list --porcelain
git -C /work/helper for-each-ref '--format=%(objectname)' refs/heads/spec-export
```

Resolve:
- `ORIGINAL_HEAD = O`
- `baseRefName = trunk`
- `BASE_SHA = B`
- settings: defaults
- keyed home contract: `.worktrees/<name>`
- `WORKTREE = H`

The final two commands identify existing checkouts and the actual local branch tip. A checkout elsewhere stops before writes. An existing remote branch bypasses fresh-branch collision rejection and new-branch creation.

### E — Existing local branch ancestry

```sh
git -C /work/helper merge-base --is-ancestor refs/heads/spec-export origin/spec-export
```

An ancestor takes the ordinary provisioning row. A nonancestor is **not rejected until coordinated recovery has been considered**.

### P — Fresh-tree safety and existing-branch checkout

For creation paths, after all relevant stops and proofs:

```sh
git -C /work/helper status --porcelain
git -C /work/helper check-ignore -q .worktrees
```

The source is clean and the ignore check succeeds. No ignore-file write or commit occurs.

For an existing, ordinary ancestor branch, first:

```sh
git -C /work/helper update-ref refs/heads/spec-export origin/spec-export
```

Then, for every fresh checkout in this case:

```sh
git -C /work/helper worktree add /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export spec-export
git -C /work/helper rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir
git -C /work/helper worktree list --porcelain
git -C /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export rev-parse HEAD
```

The common-directory read confirms `/work/helper/.git`; the worktree listing confirms `H`. **No `-b`, `-B`, reset, branch deletion, or `branch -f` is used.** With no local branch, Git’s unique-remote DWIM provisions the existing published branch. Expected HEAD is `O`, or `R` for validated recovery.

### U — Reuse an ordinary selected tree

```sh
git -C /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export status --porcelain
git -C /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export merge --ff-only origin/spec-export
git -C /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export rev-parse HEAD
```

Resolve clean status and exact HEAD `O`.

### K — Coordinated recovery proof

For an existing selected recovery tree, first check active-rebase paths:

```sh
git -C /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path rebase-merge
git -C /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path rebase-apply
test -d /work/helper/.git/worktrees/spec-export/rebase-merge
test -d /work/helper/.git/worktrees/spec-export/rebase-apply
```

Neither directory exists. A false `test -d` is the absence observation, not a workflow error.

Then prove the actual branch tip:

```sh
git -C /work/helper rev-parse refs/heads/spec-export
git -C /work/helper merge-base --is-ancestor O refs/heads/spec-export
git -C /work/helper log --first-parent '--format=%H %P' origin/spec-export..refs/heads/spec-export
```

Require a nonempty walk and exactly two parents on **every** entry. For the valid `R O B` entry:

```sh
git -C /work/helper merge-base --is-ancestor B origin/trunk
```

For the invalid `R O X` entry, use `X` instead of `B`.

An existing selected tree must also pass:

```sh
git -C /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export status --porcelain
```

Only the complete proof admits `R`. It is reused without updating the branch. With no tree, provision using P **without** its `update-ref` command.

### S — Base sync, original-head proof, affirmative read-back

After exact-head verification:

```sh
git -C /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export merge --no-ff --no-edit origin/trunk
git -C /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export merge-base --is-ancestor O HEAD
git -C /work/helper worktree list --porcelain
git -C /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export branch --show-current
```

For successful rows, merge is a no-op, original-head ancestry succeeds, and read-backs affirmatively identify `H` and exactly `spec-export`.

**Successful Step 4 report T(O):**

```text
Worktree ready at /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export
Branch: spec-export
Base: spec-export @ aaaaaaa (clean)
Base SHA: bbbbbbb
merge: no-op - head contains origin/trunk
Ready to implement the coordinated companion work
```

**T(R)** replaces the Base tip with `ddddddd` and adds:

```text
Base sync recovered: ddddddd
```

No companion report contains PR fields, pre-rework refs, rework-base refs, or thread work. The explicit `origin/trunk` base supplies the provenance; there is no generic default-branch warning.

**Failure inventory:** Every failure preserves `W`. The inventory lists it as:

```text
Preserved created legs:
acme/widget spec-export /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export
```

Where this invocation has also created `H`, the row adds that leg. Nothing is removed.

## Independent runs

| Run | Ordered commands, resolved outcome, and report or stop |
|---|---|
| **absent** | **I → P → S → T(O)**. No local branch exists. P omits `update-ref`; `worktree add H spec-export` uses existing-branch DWIM and checks out `O`. First checkout write is the add. Exact HEAD and both coordinated read-backs pass. |
| **ancestor** | **I → E → P → S → T(O)**. Local tip is `A`; E succeeds. P first checks source cleanliness/ignore safety, then updates only `refs/heads/spec-export` to `O`, adds the existing branch, and verifies HEAD `O`. |
| **reuse** | **I → E → U → S → T(O)**. Local tip is `A`, already selected at `H`; E succeeds. U checks cleanliness **before** the ff-only write, advances to `O`, and verifies it. No add or `update-ref`. |
| **wrapper** | **I → P → S → T(O)**. Resolve `create: helper create -b <branch> <name>`. Record `create: override skipped (contains -b)`. Do **not** execute it. The permitted existing-branch built-in add checks out `O`; append that override-skipped record to Step 4. |
| **race** | **I → P**, then stop at P’s HEAD verification: observed `X`, expected `O`. No base merge, ancestry assertion, or ready report follows. Report: `acme/helper spec-export: /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export has HEAD eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee; expected aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa.` Preserve both legs; append `acme/helper branch unverified /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export` to the inventory. |
| **elsewhere** | **I**, stopping at the checkout listing: `acme/helper: branch spec-export is checked out at /work/helper/.worktrees/foreign; finish or remove that worktree first.` No branch or worktree writes. Emit the home-only preserved-leg inventory; do not adopt or remove the foreign tree. |
| **missing** | **I**, stopping at `ls-remote` exit **2**. Fetch’s success and stale tracking ref do not establish remote existence. Report: `origin/spec-export is missing in acme/helper; on the machine that ran option 6, push spec-export from that companion's checkout, then rerun brainstorming #N`. No local ref resolution, configuration read, or write follows. On that machine the prerequisite is verification of the existing leg-file commit before pushing—not regeneration. Emit the home-only inventory. |
| **lookup-error** | **I**, stopping at `ls-remote` exit **128**: `acme/helper spec-export: git -C /work/helper ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin refs/heads/spec-export failed: fatal: unable to access origin`. Do not diagnose branch absence or use the stale tracking ref. No writes; emit the home-only inventory. |
| **unresolved** | **I → P**, verifying `O`; then the conflict sequence below. Abort restores `O`, but return `merge: unresolved - lib/a.ts` to the coordinated caller for its **by-hand stop**. No ready report, PR workflow, or implementation follows. Preserve both legs, adding `acme/helper spec-export /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export`. |
| **recover-tree** | **I → E** yields local nonancestor `R`; **K** then proves `O` ancestry, nonempty walk exactly `R O B`, two parents, `B` ancestry of `origin/trunk`, no active rebase, and a clean selected tree. Verify with `git -C H rev-parse HEAD` → `R`. **S → T(R)**. No checkout, reset, ref update, or branch recreation occurs. |
| **recover-add** | **I → E → K**, omitting K’s selected-tree commands because no tree exists. The same complete merge-only proof admits `R`. **P without update-ref → S → T(R)**. Add the existing branch, verify `R`, and retain it unchanged. |
| **invalid-linear** | **I → E → K**. Local tip is `X`; published-head ancestry holds, but the nonempty walk is `X O`: only **one** parent. Stop before checkout or ref writes: `acme/helper spec-export carries commits beyond the published branch head that are not validated base-sync merges; resolve by hand.` Preserve local `X`; emit the home-only inventory. |
| **invalid-parent** | **I → E → K**. Walk is `R O X`; the two-parent shape passes, but `git -C /work/helper merge-base --is-ancestor X origin/trunk` exits 1. Stop before writes with the same invalid-base-sync diagnosis, explicitly naming second parent `X` as not contained in `origin/trunk`. Preserve `R`; emit the home-only inventory. |
| **invalid-dirty** | **I → E → K**. Graph proof passes, but selected-tree status reports ` M lib/a.ts`. Recovery requires a clean existing tree: stop rather than reuse, reset, stash, clean, or offer the ordinary dirty-source bypass. Report the dirt verbatim and the failed recovery requirement. Emit the home-only created-leg inventory and separately identify existing `H` as preserved. |
| **ordinary-control** | Use the separate PR-home sequence below. The coordinated exemption does **not** apply; stop at the unchanged ordinary PR ancestry gate, before writes. |

## Unresolved companion: exact conflict boundary

After I and P:

```sh
git -C /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export merge --no-ff --no-edit origin/trunk
git -C /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export status --porcelain
git -C /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export diff --name-only --diff-filter=U
```

Resolve the conflict list to exactly `lib/a.ts`.

Read the first available overrides file **from B**, in ladder order:

```sh
sh -c 'for p in .pi/gauntlet-overrides.md gauntlet-overrides.md doc/gauntlet-overrides.md; do if git -C /work/helper cat-file -e bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb:"$p" 2>/dev/null; then git -C /work/helper show bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb:"$p"; break; fi; done'
```

Resolve `SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS = node --test lib/a.test.mjs`, credential-free.

Dispatch one fresh foreground `implementer` with:
- `cwd: /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export`
- `async: false`
- exact allowed paths: `lib/a.ts`
- fetched base: `B`
- scoped command: `node --test lib/a.test.mjs`
- preserve both sides, stage the resolved file, no outside edits, commits, aborts, or additional tests.

The helper fails. I do **not** claim it ran or passed the scoped test. I do not attempt completion or commit:

```sh
git -C /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export merge --abort
git -C /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export rev-parse HEAD
git -C /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export branch --show-current
git -C /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export status --porcelain --untracked-files=all
git -C /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export merge-base --is-ancestor O HEAD
```

Resolve abort exit 0, HEAD `O`, branch `spec-export`, clean status, and original-head ancestry. Record `merge: unresolved - lib/a.ts`; return the unresolved result for the coordinated by-hand stop.

## Ordinary singleton control: unchanged stop

All commands retain the same process cwd:

```sh
git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-dir --git-common-dir
git -C /work/widget rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree
git -C /work/widget fetch origin
git -C /work/widget rev-parse --verify -q O^{commit}
git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/spec-export
git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/trunk
git -C /work/widget worktree list --porcelain
git -C /work/widget rev-parse refs/heads/spec-export
git -C /work/widget merge-base --is-ancestor refs/heads/spec-export origin/spec-export
```

Resolve primary `ROOT=/work/widget`, selected home `W`, supplied PR head `O`, fetched base `B`, and local tip `R`. The final command exits 1.

There is no coordinated marked-home context and no validated rework recovery. I do not apply the companion merge-only proof:

```text
local branch spec-export is at ddddddd, not an ancestor of origin/spec-export (aaaaaaa); rework needs the PR head.
```

Stop before any checkout, ref write, sync, spec, or thread work. Preserve the existing workspaces; emit no `Worktree ready at` line.
